I added `migrations/0001_add_last_login.sql`:

```sql
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN last_login_at TIMESTAMP NULL;
```

The column allows NULL, so existing users and anyone who has never logged in simply have no value.

This file won't change anything when the app runs yet. The project has no SQL database or migration tool: `src/db.js` is an in-memory store with the data written into the code. I used plain SQL that should work on Postgres, MySQL and SQLite. If you pick Postgres, you may want `TIMESTAMPTZ` instead of `TIMESTAMP` so the time zone is stored too.

If you also want the in-memory store to have the column, I can add `last_login_at: null` to the user rows in `src/db.js`. I haven't committed anything.
